DESCEND 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Quadriceps
SECONDARY
Gluteals

Instructions

1

Brace with the bar across upper traps.

2

Bend hips and knees; keep heels grounded.

3

Keep knees tracking with your toes.

4

Stay braced at your comfortable squat depth.

5

Push through your whole feet to rise.

6

Stand tall without leaning back.

Watch out

If your knees cave inward on the way up, think push the floor apart with your feet. This is the #1 form error and it costs you power.

COMMON MISTAKES

Knees caving inward (valgus) on the drive out of the hole.
Heels lifting / weight shifting onto the toes.
Cutting depth short of parallel under heavier loads.
